# Cherry Magic Apartment | Sarajevo

> A bright, modern 2-bedroom short-stay apartment in Sarajevo's prestigious, green Višnjik neighbourhood (Bolnička 46). Accommodates up to 6 guests (5+1 setup) with full baby-friendly amenities, free street parking, a 24/7 attended paid parking lot across the street, high-speed Wi-Fi, full kitchen, and self check-in via smart lock. Located just a 15-minute gentle walk from historic Baščaršija (Old Town) and within 300 meters of Sarajevo's central medical and clinical institutions.

## Core Property Details
- **Property Type**: Self-catering vacation rental apartment (recently renovated)
- **Address**: Bolnička 46, Višnjik, Sarajevo 71000, Bosnia and Herzegovina
- **Coordinates / Location**: Višnjik neighbourhood, Centar Sarajevo (Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/1NodYVh41EmzkMa78)
- **Capacity**: Sleeps up to 6 guests (2 bedrooms + living room pull-out sofa bed)
- **Bedroom 1**: Queen-sized bed, freshly renovated, quiet courtyard side
- **Bedroom 2**: Twin beds / cozy second room, ideal for children, relatives or a second couple
- **Living Area**: South-facing sunlit living room with large comfortable sofa, dining space, flat-screen cable TV
- **Kitchen**: Fully equipped self-catering kitchen with island, stove, oven, vent, dishwasher, refrigerator, basic spices, and complimentary tea and coffee
- **Bathroom**: Modern bathroom with shower, fresh towels, hotel-quality toiletries, hair dryer, and first aid kit
- **Laundry**: Washing machine and dryer available for stays of 5 nights or more upon request
- **Climate**: Air conditioning (cooling and heating) plus central heating

## Family & Baby Amenities
- Baby travel cot / crib (available on request before arrival)
- High chair for toddlers
- Baby safety locks and outlet covers
- Toddler toilet seat adapter and bathroom step stool
- Child-friendly toys and quiet residential setting for uninterrupted sleep

## Check-in, Parking & Practical Arrival
- **Check-in**: From 15:00 (earlier arrival upon prior request) via secure smart lock self check-in
- **Check-out**: By 11:10 AM
- **Tap Water**: Sarajevo municipal water is 100% clean and safe to drink straight from any tap in the apartment
- **Street Parking**: Free public street parking along Bolnička street in front of the building
- **Attended Parking**: 24/7 guarded, paid parking lot located directly across the street (1 BAM / KM per hour)
